messages:
Alex K: dropping the third-party pentest bundle here: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/pt/1840001234/bundle.zip. Quick summary: session fixation (CVSS 7.2), embed-worker uses old dep (moderate), internal S3 ACL misconfig. Need remediation timeline for customer's vendor risk review.
Maria G: forwarding to customer risk. They asked for remediations + repro steps + verification evidence. Can we get ETAs today?
Danielle R: I'll own the embed-worker dep. Plan: bump dep, run unit + integration, canary for 24h. ETA 3 business days. Will open PR and include test artifacts.
Sam D: once PR is up I'll run perf across dedicated staging. Share exact commit SHA. If memory or p95 regresses we'll halt canary.
SecOps Bot: Dynamic scan (2026-03-21T11:06:00Z) completed for branch feature/pt-fixes. Results: 2 high, 3 medium. Report: s3://redwood-secops-scans/1840001234/report.html
Alex K: auth issue looks like cookie rotation gap during token refresh. Danielle/Priya can you propose verification steps the customer can run? They want automated test commands.
Priya S: For auth fix verification: 1) run ./tests/ssorotate.sh --simulate 2) confirm old session rejected, new session active 3) grep logs for "session-rotated" events. I'll add these to the testpack.
Danielle R: S3 ACL fix is trivial, doing that now and will push a commit. I'll post screenshots of the ACL change in evidence.
Maria G: customer requires signed test plan + CVSS mapping per item. I'll prepare the cover note but need timelines.
Sam D: perf test script for PR: `python perf/run_batch.py --model=longform --concurrency=6 --duration=180` include before/after p50/p95. Also add eval prompt set to guard against quality regressions.
Danielle R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1272 commit 2b7e6f. Bumped dep, added e2e for SSO rotate, removed public ACL. Test logs uploaded to evidence folder.
Alex K: please paste commit SHA and a short remediation blurb for each CVE here. I'll collate for the vendor packet.
Danielle R: CVE mapping: auth/session fixation (CVSS 7.2) -> invalidation + rotate cookie salt; embed-worker dep (CVSS 6.5) -> bump to v2.4.1, re-run model tests; S3 ACL (low) -> removed public grants. Verification: unit + e2e + perf.
SecOps Bot: Ticket #VULN-184000 created and assigned to Danielle R. Evidence attachments: bundle.zip, scan-report.html, test-logs.tar.gz.
Maria G: I told the customer we're targeting an internal retest by Friday EOD and handing off for their verification on Monday. They asked for proof screenshots and test commands.
Sam D: will run perf tomorrow AM and post results. If quantization or latency regresses on dedicated, I'll propose rollback and block the canary.
Alex K: good. Once retest artifacts are in place we'll mark for third-party verification. Thanks all.
Maria G: Customer replied: "Received the artifacts and PR link. We'll try to schedule verification Mon morning." Closing loop and will update deal tracker after verification. :white_check_mark:
